item.title: Where to see America’s national bird in Utah during winter migrations
item.description: Division of Wildlife Resources press release SALT LAKE CITY — February is typically the best time of the year to see America’s national bird here in Utah. Bald eagles fly to Utah in the winter to find food and escape colder conditions farther north, and by late January and February, hundreds of eagles are typically in the state.
